call_purpose: You reached out because leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not going out to them.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and after a test form submission you confirmed the email arrived and everything is now working correctly.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes land in spam, so it is a good idea to verify your sender domain, which you can do in the email domain section of Settings.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings.
